changelog: More Like This now uses TMDB's own recommendations and similar titles for the title you're on, ranked ahead of genre matches from your catalog, so the row shows titles people who liked it actually watch. Titles it hadn't seen before are added as requestable. Each title appears once: a library copy and a TMDB copy of the same show no longer both show up, and a title never recommends itself. Requires Jellyfin 12.1 or later. This is a beta release.
description: Server-side intelligence engine for the Orca X TV app: personalization, recommendations, caching, and centralized administration.
